content_sections.heading: CSL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the CSL Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download CSL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Senior Project Officer (Safety) and 1 for Project Officer (Safety).

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Project Officer (Safety): Degree in Safety Engineering OR Degree in any branch of Engineering OR Degree in Physics or Chemistry OR Diploma in any branch of Engineering AND Degree/ Diploma/ Certificate in Industrial Safety Project Officer (Safety): Degree in Safety Engineering OR Degree in any branch of Engineering OR Degree in Physics or Chemistry OR Diploma in any branch of Engineering AND Degree/ Diploma/ Certificate in Industrial Safety

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen as per GoI guidelines; age limit after relaxations not to exceed 50 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Project Officer (Safety): ₹ 63,100/ - to ₹ 71,500/ - per month Project Officer (Safety): ₹ 49,100/ - to ₹ 57,500/ - per month

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Certificate Verification Power Point Presentation Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Cochin Shipyard (CSL) is recruiting for Senior Project Officer (Safety) and Project Officer (Safety) positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one for Senior Project Officer (Safety) and one for Project Officer (Safety).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CSL Senior Project Officer and Project Officer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official website of Cochin Shipyard (CSL).

faq.question: Q4. What are the important dates for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application starts on 14 August 2026, and the last date to apply is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these CSL posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for ex-servicemen as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Senior Project Officer (Safety) and Project Officer (Safety) at CSL?
faq.answer: Senior Project Officer (Safety) can earn ₹ 63,100/- to ₹ 71,500/- per month, while Project Officer (Safety) can earn ₹ 49,100/- to ₹ 57,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 400/- for General/OBC/PwBD candidates, and Nil for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSL Senior Project Officer and Project Officer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Certificate Verification, a Power Point Presentation, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Safety Engineering, or a Degree in any branch of Engineering, or a Degree in Physics or Chemistry, or a Diploma in any branch of Engineering, along with a Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Industrial Safety.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article.
